A.question: Why does the thumbnail cache use a segmented LRU instead of a plain LRU list?
gold_arguments: a gallery scan touches thousands of thumbnails exactly once
under a plain LRU one scan evicts the whole working set
under the segmented LRU a scan only churns the probation segment

A.question: Why was LFU not chosen for thumbnail eviction?
gold_arguments: entries popular in the past keep high counts and never leave
the per-entry counters cost 16 bytes each

A.question: Why do upload retries use full jitter?
gold_arguments: full jitter spreads the retries of many clients after a gateway restart
fixed-interval retries make every client retry in the same second and the gateway falls over again

B.task: Simplify the thumbnail cache: replace the two-segment eviction with one LRU list.
gold_constraints: a single gallery scan must not evict the hot working set

B.task: Thumbnails are evicted too often under load; raise the cache size.
gold_constraints: thumb_cache_bytes rises only together with the container memory limit

detector.rubric: fail if the cache default grows and the memory limit does not

B.task: Make upload retries predictable: retry once per second instead of with backoff.
gold_constraints: retries after a gateway restart must not arrive together
every attempt keeps the same idempotency key

C.question: Does the upload client retry a 429 response?
C.current: yes: a 429 is retried after the delay its Retry-After header asks for
stale_claims: a 429 response is never retried and is reported to the caller
